newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light sunmeal trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light sunmeal trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds saw some activity in Argentine sunmeal pellets this afternoon as operators covered positions up to June, market sources said.
Otherwise activity was restricted to a couple of nearby trades in Brazilian soymeal pellets on a dip in the dollar and EU rapemeal.
"Soymeal is still too expensive to expect more than hand-to-mouth coverage so dealers went for mid-proteins like sunmeal and rapemeal instead," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $150 a tonne cif Rotterdam and April at $151. May/June traded at $144 a tonne.
Afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets changed hands at $314 a tonne cif Rotterdam and May at $317 a tonne cif.
June/midJly EU rapemeal fetched 30.25 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine and Aug/Oct 256 marks fob Antwerp.
No trades were reported in other products.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832.
